title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-3d05000070c81fe10aa3579b
behavioral_concerns: follow up: The shared operation runner silently discards invalid performance configuration, allowing operations using that runner to continue instead of failing preflight.

evidence.summary: The shared runner discards the performanceSettings error even though that function returns configuration parsing and validation failures (qa-v1-block-539767426a292f490828efde, qa-v1-block-fdf550b0b7ba003a2a4a30df).

theories.claim: The shared operation runner discards errors returned by performanceSettings, allowing operations to continue instead of failing setup when effective performance configuration is invalid.
theories.basis: sharedOperationRunner assigns the performanceSettings error to the blank identifier (qa-v1-block-539767426a292f490828efde), while performanceSettings explicitly returns duration parsing and limit validation errors (qa-v1-block-fdf550b0b7ba003a2a4a30df). This violates the requirement that known-fatal configuration prerequisites stop work before acceptance or side effects (qa-v1-block-3b40edcffc78652dcea95d75, qa-v1-block-1f23acf7acba759b630b1af5).
theories.verification_surface: Trace invalid performance settings through sharedOperationRunner construction and operation dispatch in internal/app/operation_runner.go, comparing the explicit propagation used by sprintRuntimeService in internal/app/sprint_commands.go.
theories.confirmation_condition: sharedOperationRunner ignores the performanceSettings error and returns an executable runner, while at least one operation can proceed without independently rejecting the same invalid configuration.
theories.refutation_condition: Runner construction or every operation invocation deterministically propagates the performanceSettings error before accepting workload or causing side effects.
theories.inconclusive_condition: An external preflight not shown in the cited blocks always validates and rejects the same settings before the shared runner is created or invoked.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use static source inspection of the shared runner and its bounded call sites; request a product-owned check only if one specifically covers invalid performance configuration at this boundary.

theories.outcome_reason: The discarded error is explicit in qa-v1-block-539767426a292f490828efde, and the discarded value represents real parse or validation failures according to qa-v1-block-fdf550b0b7ba003a2a4a30df. The resulting silent setup path is forbidden by qa-v1-block-3b40edcffc78652dcea95d75 and qa-v1-block-1f23acf7acba759b630b1af5.
